rows.Kwic: 父子有親，君臣有義，夫婦有別，長幼有序，朋友有信。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Hansong Zhicao (寒松操禪師語錄): in his Xianglu Monastery discourse, Hansong Zhicao lists duty between lord and minister among the five relations.

rows.Kwic: 談玄談玅，無殊指鹿為馬；行棒行喝，何異畫餅充饑？

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Hansong Zhicao (寒松操禪師語錄): in his Yunji Monastery discourse, Hansong Zhicao compares wielding staff and shout to filling hunger with a painted cake.
